_meta.purpose: EMERGENCY and HIGH referral routing. Ranks credible nearby facilities — government and private — by capability, affordability, quality and travel time, from real coordinates, with no paid API required.
_meta.coordinates: District headquarters, where the District Hospital / District Combined Hospital sits. Accurate to the town; exact enough for nearest-facility routing across a state the size of UP.
_meta.capacity: NOT INCLUDED BY DESIGN. There is no public real-time bed-availability feed for UP facilities. Any number here would be invented, and an invented bed count on a referral screen is dangerous. The UI shows the facility's phone number and instructs the health worker to confirm capacity before transporting.
_meta.phone_numbers: Where a verified public number was not available the field is null and the UI falls back to the national 108 ambulance line rather than showing a wrong number.

schema.facility_type: district_hospital | medical_college | chc | phc | private_multispeciality | private_singlespeciality | null
schema.capabilities: array of: trauma, obstetric, paediatric, cardiac, icu, blood_bank. NULL means UNKNOWN, never 'none' — an empty array would claim we confirmed the facility has none of them.
schema.pmjay_empanelled: true | false | null. Drives the cost line on the card: an empanelled private hospital is cashless for the patient, a non-empanelled one can bankrupt them.
schema.phone: E.164 or local dialling string | null
schema.sources: Per-field provenance: { field: { source, retrieved } }. A field with no entry here was not sourced and MUST be null.

_meta.sourcing_rule: Null where unsourced; never guess. A fabricated capability or empanelment flag would route a critical patient to a facility that cannot treat them or cannot afford to — strictly worse than admitting we do not know. Populate with scripts/ingestFacilities.js against a real source.
_meta.coverage: Government district hospitals only, one per district. Private and empanelled facilities are NOT yet seeded: no verified public source has been ingested. The ranking engine handles them the moment the data exists.
